Craftsmanship

From Sketch to Harvest

Every piece in Reference 0711 travels through seven disciplines inside the Star Jewellery atelier — nothing outsourced, nothing hurried.

Design

Every bead is measured before the drawing begins — the setting grows around the stone.

CAD

Trellises, channels and bead cups modelled to micron tolerances.

Manufacturing

Investment casting in certified 14 and 18 karat alloys.

Stone Setting

Beads capped and pinned, rubies calibré-set in channel, diamonds pavé under 10× loupe.

Polishing

Mirror finishes brought up by hand, wire by wire.

Quality

Every weight, count and clarity grade audited against the quotation master.

Presentation

Photographed, documented and cased under Ref 0711.

About the Collection

The Fruit of Slow Ground

A vineyard is the least hurried thing a person can plant. Rows are set out for a harvest years away, the fruit is picked by hand, and the best of it is the part that took longest to ripen. Bead-set jewellery is made the same way — one drilled stone at a time, matched by eye for colour before a single one is pinned.

Reference 0711 is Star Jewellery's harvest: twenty-seven compositions in which emerald, ruby, tanzanite and amethyst hang in clusters, rows and drops from architecture of diamond and white gold. It is a collection about abundance held in place.
